cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), her classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10), Mum, Dad and Max. School objects are shown on their own; subjects as a lesson in action, with no writing on boards or paper.

words.en: Sam is in the advanced class.
words.scene: A classroom wall chart with three steps going up, the top step with a gold star; Sam standing proudly on the top step, smaller children on the lower steps, no writing.
more: This book is too advanced for Tom.
这本书对 Tom 来说太难了。
Lily wants to join the advanced class.

words.en: Tom is a beginner at swimming.
words.scene: Tom in a swimming pool wearing armbands, holding a float, a kind teacher helping him, other beginners in the shallow end.
more: I'm a beginner at the piano.

words.en: We learn about animals in biology.
words.sz: 我们在生物课上学习动物。
words.scene: A biology lesson: children looking at a leaf through a microscope, a poster of a frog's life cycle and a plant with roots on the wall, no writing.
more: 生物是 Lily 最喜欢的科目。

words.en: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
words.scene: A big old-style green-black blackboard on a classroom wall with simple chalk drawings of a sun, a house and a cat, a stick of white chalk on the ledge, no writing.
more: Tom cleans the blackboard after class.

words.en: Write your name on the board.
words.scene: A clean white board on a classroom wall with colourful marker drawings of fruit, three markers on the ledge, no writing.
more: The teacher draws a map on the board.
老师在板上画了一张地图。

words.en: Lily reads a book every week.
words.scene: One colourful children's picture book standing open, a cute bear drawn on the page, no writing.
senses: Dad books a table for dinner.

words.en: Dad books a table at the cafe.
words.sz: 爸爸在咖啡馆订了一张桌子。
words.scene: Dad on the phone booking a table at a cafe, with a thought bubble showing a cosy cafe table for four with a little vase of flowers and a small card that has only a green tick on it, Lily listening happily; nothing written anywhere.
more: Let's book a room by the sea.
我们订一间海边的房间吧。
You need to book the tickets early.

words.en: Put the books on the bookshelf.
words.scene: One wooden bookshelf full of colourful books, a toy dinosaur and a small plant on top.
more: There is a big bookshelf in the classroom.

words.en: We do experiments in chemistry.
words.sz: 我们在化学课上做实验。
words.scene: A safe school chemistry lesson: two older students in goggles watching a bottle of coloured water bubbling, test tubes in a rack, no writing.

words.en: There are twenty children in my class.
words.scene: A happy class of about twenty children sitting at their desks, hands up, a smiling teacher at the front.
more: Our English class starts at nine.
我们的英语课九点开始。
Lily is the tallest in her class.

words.en: Mia is Lily's classmate.
words.sz: Mia 是 Lily 的同学。
words.scene: Lily and her classmate Mia, a girl with black hair in two buns, sitting side by side at their desks sharing a book.
more: Tom plays with his classmates at break.
Tom 课间和同学一起玩。

words.en: Our classroom is on the first floor.
words.scene: A bright cheerful empty classroom with rows of desks, a board, children's paintings on the walls and big windows.
more: Please be quiet in the classroom.

words.en: Lily is a clever girl.
words.scene: Lily with a big smile solving a puzzle quickly, a glowing light bulb above her head, Tom watching amazed.

words.en: Our football coach is very kind.
words.sz: 我们的足球教练人很好。
words.scene: A friendly grown-up football coach with a whistle and a clipboard, giving a thumbs up to a group of children in football kit on a pitch.
more: The coach helps us play better.
We go to London by coach.
我们坐长途大巴去伦敦。
senses: We go to London by coach.

words.en: My cousin goes to college.
words.scene: An old college building with big windows and a clock tower, young adult students walking on the lawn with books.
more: Aunt Kate teaches at a college.
Kate 姑姑在一所学院教书。
After school, I want to go to college.
中学毕业后我想上大学。

words.en: Mum is doing a cooking course.
words.scene: Mum in a cooking class with other grown-ups in aprons, a chef teacher showing them how to make bread.
more: The course is ten weeks long.
I want to do a swimming course.

words.en: Lily's books are on her desk.
words.sz: Lily 的书在她的书桌上。
words.scene: One wooden school desk with a pencil case, an open notebook and an apple on it, a chair tucked in.
more: My desk is next to the window.

words.en: Look up the word in the dictionary.
words.scene: One thick dictionary lying open on a desk, a magnifying glass and a pencil beside it, the pages full of tiny unreadable lines.
more: I need a new English dictionary.
我需要一本新的英语词典。
我能用一下你的词典吗？

words.en: My sister gets her diploma today.
words.sz: 我姐姐今天拿到毕业证书。
words.scene: A proud young woman in a graduation cap and gown holding up a rolled diploma tied with a red ribbon, family clapping.
more: Dad has a diploma in music.
爸爸有音乐专业的文凭。
You get a diploma after the course.
课程结束后你会拿到证书。

words.en: Can I borrow your eraser?
words.scene: One pink eraser next to a pencil, rubbing out a small pencil drawing of a star, crumbs of eraser on the paper.
more: My eraser is in my pencil case.
Use an eraser, not your finger.

words.en: The examination is on Friday.
words.scene: Older students sitting in quiet rows in a big hall writing an examination, a big clock on the wall, a teacher walking between the desks.
more: Please be quiet during the examination.
Sam is ready for his examination.

words.en: We learn about countries in geography.
words.sz: 我们在地理课上学习各个国家。
words.scene: A geography lesson: children around a big globe, a teacher pointing at the blue oceans, a world map on the wall, no writing.
more: 地理是我最喜欢的科目。

words.en: We learn about kings and queens in history.
words.sz: 我们在历史课上学习国王和王后。
words.scene: A history lesson: children looking at a picture of an old castle with knights, a model of a castle on the table, a toy crown.
more: We visit a castle for our history class.
我们为历史课去参观城堡。

words.en: Lily does her homework after school.
words.sz: Lily 放学后做家庭作业。
words.scene: Lily at the kitchen table after school doing her homework in a notebook, a glass of milk beside her, Max resting his head on the table.
more: Have you got any homework today?

words.en: You can find information in the library.
words.sz: 你可以在图书馆找资料。
words.scene: A friendly information desk with a big round 'i' sign, a helpful lady giving a map to a family.
more: I need some information about the zoo.
我需要一些关于动物园的信息。

words.en: Read the instructions before you start.
words.scene: Tom and Dad building a toy robot from a kit, Dad holding an instruction sheet with only simple step-by-step pictures and arrows, no writing.

words.en: I know the answer!
words.scene: Lily in class with her hand high in the air and a big excited smile, a light bulb above her head.
more: I don't know where Max is.
我不知道 Max 在哪儿。

words.en: English is a beautiful language.
words.sz: 英语是一门优美的语言。
words.scene: A group of happy children from different countries waving and saying hello, colourful speech bubbles above them with only flags and smiles, no writing.
more: How many languages can you speak?
Lily is learning a new language.

words.en: Tom is learning to swim.
words.scene: Tom learning to ride a bicycle with stabilisers in the park, Dad holding the back of the seat, Tom wobbling but smiling.
more: I want to learn the piano.

words.en: Our first lesson is maths.
words.scene: A piano lesson: a kind teacher sitting next to Lily at a piano, Lily pressing the keys.
more: The lesson starts at nine o'clock.
Lily has a swimming lesson on Saturday.

words.en: This book is at the right level for me.
words.sz: 这本书正好适合我的水平。
words.scene: A video-game-like staircase made of five coloured blocks, a cartoon Lily climbing up from the first step to the third, a star at the top.
more: What level are you in English?
Tom is at the first level.

words.en: Lily borrows books from the library.
words.scene: A cosy children's library with tall bookshelves, colourful cushions, children reading quietly, a kind librarian at the desk.

words.en: Lily gets a good mark in the test.
words.scene: Lily holding up a test paper with a big red tick and a gold star sticker on it, smiling proudly, no readable writing.
senses: There's a mark on your shirt.

words.en: Maths is Sam's favourite subject.
words.sz: 数学是 Sam 最喜欢的科目。
words.scene: A maths lesson: a board with big colourful numbers and plus and minus signs, Sam counting on an abacus.

words.en: Mum leaves a note on the fridge.
words.sz: 妈妈在冰箱上留了一张便条。
words.scene: A yellow sticky note on a fridge door with a little drawing of a heart and a smiley face, held by a magnet, no writing.
more: Lily writes a note to Tom.
Lily 给 Tom 写了张便条。

words.en: We learn about light and sound in physics.
words.sz: 我们在物理课上学光和声音。
words.scene: A physics lesson: older students playing with magnets and iron filings, a toy car rolling down a ramp, a teacher smiling.
more: My brother is good at physics.

words.en: Football practice is on Tuesday.
words.scene: Football practice on a school field, children dribbling balls around orange cones, a coach blowing a whistle.

words.en: Lily practises the piano every day.
words.scene: Lily practising the piano at home in the evening, Max sitting next to the piano listening.
more: Practise your English with a friend.
Tom practises football in the garden.

words.en: Our class is doing a project on animals.
words.sz: 我们班在做关于动物的课题。
words.scene: A group of children making a big colourful poster about animals together, gluing pictures of a lion, an elephant and a fish, glue and scissors on the table, no writing.
more: We work on the project in groups.

words.en: There are three hundred pupils in our school.
words.sz: 我们学校有三百个学生。
words.scene: A line of happy young pupils in school uniform walking into a primary school with their school bags, a teacher waving at the door.

words.en: Lily likes to read in bed.
words.scene: Lily reading a book in bed with a small lamp on, Max curled up asleep at her feet.

words.en: Remember to take your homework!
words.scene: Tom at the front door with his school bag, Mum handing him his forgotten homework book, Tom slapping his forehead and laughing.
more: 你还记得我们的假期吗？

words.en: Can I borrow your rubber, please?
words.scene: One white rubber with a blue sleeve next to a pencil and a small pencil drawing being rubbed out.
more: My rubber is very small now.
Use a rubber to fix it.

words.en: Draw a line with a ruler.
words.scene: One long wooden ruler lying on a desk next to a pencil and a straight pencil line, no numbers shown.
more: My ruler is thirty centimetres long.
我能用一下你的尺子吗？

words.en: Lily walks to school with Mum.
words.sz: Lily 和妈妈走路去学校。
words.scene: A friendly red-brick primary school building with a playground, a big clock, children arriving with backpacks.
more: School starts at half past eight.

words.en: We grow plants in science.
words.sz: 我们在科学课上种植物。
words.scene: A science lesson: children watering small bean plants in pots on a sunny windowsill, one child measuring a plant.

words.en: My cousin is a student at university.
words.scene: A young grown-up university student with a backpack and books walking across a campus lawn, smiling.
more: There are thirty students in the class.
The students are listening to the teacher.

words.en: My sister is busy with her studies.
words.scene: A teenage girl at a desk piled with books and notes, studying hard with a lamp and a cup of tea, late in the evening.
more: After his studies, Sam wants to travel.

words.en: Lily studies English at school.
words.scene: Lily and Sam studying together at a table in the library, books open, writing in notebooks.
more: I study for the test every evening.
What do you want to study?

words.en: What's your favourite subject?
words.scene: A school timetable drawn as colourful picture tiles only: a globe, a paintbrush, a football, numbers, a test tube and a music note, no writing.
more: 美术是我最喜欢的科目。
We study ten subjects at school.
我们在学校学十门科目。

words.en: Mum teaches me to cook.
words.scene: Mum teaching Lily how to cut vegetables safely in the kitchen, guiding her hands, both smiling.
more: Can you teach me to swim?

words.en: Our teacher is very kind.
words.scene: A kind smiling grown-up woman teacher at the front of a classroom holding a book, children with their hands up.
more: Lily wants to be a teacher.

words.en: The new term starts in September.
words.scene: Children walking back to school on a sunny autumn morning, orange leaves falling, new backpacks, parents waving goodbye.
more: There are three terms in a year.
This term we are learning about space.
这学期我们在学太空知识。

words.en: We have a spelling test today.
words.scene: Children in a classroom doing a short test, pencils moving, a sand timer on the teacher's desk, no readable writing.
more: Lily is ready for the test.

words.en: My cousin goes to university.
words.scene: A grand old university building with columns and a dome, young adult students in graduation caps throwing them in the air.
more: Dad studied at university in London.
Sam wants to go to university.
